raw_description:
A cathedral stained-glass window pane. An elder adult emperor
penguin passing a cupped ritual flame from its flippers into the
flippers of a younger adult emperor penguin. Ruby-red and gold glass
panels dominate, with warm flame-orange center light. Lead-divided
jewel-toned glass, ornate borders. Symbol of lineage, continuity,
and ritual.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: Cathedral stained-glass window pane rendered in the tradition of a Gothic altarpiece panel; lead-divided jewel-toned glass with thick black lead lines, ornate pointed-arch borders at the edges, light transmitting through colored glass panels; rich saturated pigments, contemplative and ceremonial register; single square composition centered for hex clipping

SUBJECT: Two adult emperor penguins in upright lean posture — tall narrow frames, small proportional dark eyes, sleek plumage, pointed beaks — facing each other in a ritual gesture; the elder penguin extends cupped flippers cradling a living flame toward the younger adult penguin whose cupped flippers receive it; both figures rendered with full adult anatomical gravity, no juvenile softness

CONTEXT: A full cathedral stained-glass window pane; the two figures occupy the central medallion, the passing flame glowing at the geometric center; ornate Gothic tracery and bordered arch panels frame the scene as an altarpiece moment of transmission

COLOR: Ruby-red glass panels (#1E4A85 deep border shadow) dominate the flanking fields; warm flame-orange and amber gold saturate the central medallion around the cupped flippers; elder penguin rendered in deep ocean blue-black plumage; warm ochre (#C18A63) gold tracery borders; secondary warm parchment (#E0D4A8) glow radiates from the flame outward into surrounding panels

DETAILS: Lead lines divide each color field cleanly; flame casts warm transmitted light across both figures' chests; glass surface clean and vibrant with no extraneous weathering
